notes: Covered: Zagreb city + Velika Gorica/Zaprešić/Samobor, Split/Sinj/Trogir, Rijeka + Opatija/Krk/Mali Lošinj, Istria (Pula, Rovinj, Žminj, Umag, Poreč, Buje, Buzet), Osijek, Zadar, Šibenik, Dubrovnik, Varaždin, Karlovac, Slavonski Brod, Koprivnica, Bjelovar, Vinkovci, Vukovar, Čakovec, Gospić, Sisak area. Duty rotas: no official city/county 'dežurstvo veterinara' rota was found anywhere in Croatia; Hrvatska veterinarska komora (hvk.hr) register did not surface in search and was not opened. In Zagreb the city-owned Veterinarska stanica Grada Zagreba sends all out-of-hours cases to the private Buba clinic (060 600 100); the university hospital (VEF) takes emergencies 0-24 walk-in. A 2025 SiB.hr article says Osijek has no formal shifts - each practice runs its own standby. Karlovac (VS Karlovac) has 0-24 duty on Sundays/holidays only. Poison line: none for animals exists that we could find; the IMI Centar za kontrolu otrovanja (+385 1 2348 342, 0-24) is a human poison centre and its pages do not mention animals - vets are the first call. Blocked/unfetchable: veterinarska.hr/pripravnost, vetvision.hr (robots), zoo-vet.hr (robots), veterina-porec.com (robots), veterinari-crikvenica.hr (robots), vaistravet.hr and mustac-vet.hr (redirect loop), veto-doo.hr, mnovine.hr dežurni veterinari (Makarska), korculainfo.com, vetti-group.hr (robots), porec.hr servisne informacije. Klinika Kreszinger now redirects to vetti-buba.hr (not listed separately). Still to do: Makarska, Hvar, Korčula, Brač (Vet Vision Supetar), Omiš, Kaštela, Vodice, Biograd, Pag, Crikvenica, Zadar private clinics (Zoo-vet, Mustać, Puntamika), Dubrovnik others (Fauna, Campi, Anima Vita), Sisak town, Slavonski Brod Veto, Happy Vet / VIPet / VET-svijet / Veterina Branimir / Vet Vision in Zagreb (no own pages reachable), Krapina, Virovitica, Požega, Đakovo, Našice. Entries without 'small_animals' are mixed or unstated practices.
